configuration.prompt_text: Evaluate every W001 v2 synthetic case against its supplied documents, prior invoice IDs and stated tax rate. Apply exact matching and arithmetic, identify missing/contradictory/out-of-scope/invalid fields, never guess, return ACCEPT or REVIEW with issue codes or ABSTAIN if not resolvable. No external data or payment. This is a known development suite; prior discussion and code are visible, not a blind model test.
